evidence_cards.content: The system shall generate log files as follows for reports: Device Command Log (contains device commands issued with time stamp, operator ID, unit where the command was issued at and shall include failed or aborted commands), System Operation Command Log (contains system operational commands issued with time stamp, operator ID, unit where the command was issued at and shall include failed or aborted commands), Problem Work Order Log (generated automatically with failure information at the time of failure), Alarm Log (contains information about warning and critical alarm events), Daily Diary Log (generated automatically when a user with Operator authority logs on to the system), Special Event Log (contains information about scheduled special events), and System Operation Schedule Log (contains information about scheduled operations).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: These log types represent the system state components that must exist and be populated before Management can generate a Failure Summary Report summarizing status values indicating failure from them.
